scope: Citywide daily counts, all offenses; dashboard filters do not apply to these precomputed experiments.
target: One day ahead: reported incident count. Observed prior-day counts are assumed available without reporting delay.
limitations: Retrospective incident-date data may be revised; no historical as-of snapshots are available. Real-time performance may be worse.
Quarterly refits; actual observed lag counts update each test day. These are not recursive year-ahead forecasts.
Fixed hyperparameters specified before evaluation; no test-set tuning or model selection refit claimed.
No external validation, causal inference, individual risk prediction, or deployment of a real-time model.
